inputCutoffRule: Features from exact as-of authoritative state; private future schedules, future realized events, future completion/dock outcomes and counterfactual results excluded. Rule-derived predictors explicitly identified.

split.unit: Scenario, seed and incident sequence; all adjacent snapshots, nodes, policies and counterfactuals remain grouped.
split.finalSetRule: Fresh seeds and frozen previously unseen/larger families; never used for model selection.

remainingArrivalSec.definition: future authoritative road arrivalSec minus cutoff clockSec
remainingArrivalSec.eligible: Active truck not yet road-arrived, actual arrival observed before generation horizon
remainingArrivalSec.excludes: Subsequent dock queue/service; prediction/conditionalETA is not truth

deliveryLate.definition: Any actually assigned carried delivery has authoritative deliveredAtSec greater than its deadlineSec (existing numerical tolerance)
deliveryLate.eligible: Undelivered prospective assignment and complete final carried-delivery outcomes

futureImpact.mapping: Use actual resourceIds and TRUCK:truckIds recorded by each impact; no inferred resource links.
futureImpact.eligible: Full future window coverage or absorbing all-work-completed terminal state; unfinished right-censored windows masked.
notTarget: Existing onset at or before cutoff
futureImpact.interpretation: New recorded operational adverse event association, including configured contention/deadline effects; not proven incident-caused propagation.

separateObservedBrazilLabel.definition: For eligible status-delivered rows with actual+estimated dates, date(actual)>date(estimated).
